---
- name: Create opsbot on node1 and generate its SSH key
  hosts: control
  become: yes
  gather_facts: no
  tasks:
    - name: Create opsbot user with home directory
      user:
        name: opsbot
        shell: /bin/bash
        create_home: yes
        password_lock: [REDACTED]

    - name: Generate ed25519 SSH keypair for opsbot
      user:
        name: opsbot
        generate_ssh_key: yes
        ssh_key_type: ed25519
        ssh_key_file: .ssh/id_ed25519
        ssh_key_comment: "opsbot@node1"

    - name: Read opsbot public key
      slurp:
        src: /home/opsbot/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub
      register: opsbot_pubkey_b64

    - name: Expose opsbot public key as a fact
      set_fact:
        opsbot_pubkey: "{{ opsbot_pubkey_b64.content | b64decode }}"

    - name: Enforce key-only SSH auth for opsbot
      blockinfile:
        path: /etc/ssh/sshd_config
        marker: "# {mark} ANSIBLE MANAGED BLOCK - opsbot key-only auth"
        block: |
          Match User opsbot
              PubkeyAuthentication yes
              PasswordAuthentication no
              AuthenticationMethods publickey
      register: node1_sshd_conf

    - name: Validate sshd config syntax
      command: sshd -t
      changed_when: false

    - name: Restart sshd
      service:
        name: sshd
        state: restarted
      when: node1_sshd_conf.changed

- name: Create opsbot on node2 and authorize node1's opsbot key
  hosts: remote
  become: yes
  gather_facts: no
  tasks:
    - name: Create opsbot user with home directory
      user:
        name: opsbot
        shell: /bin/bash
        create_home: yes
        password_lock: [REDACTED]

    - name: Authorize node1's opsbot public key for opsbot on node2
      authorized_key:

    - name: Enforce key-only SSH auth for opsbot

    - name: Validate sshd config syntax
      command: sshd -t
      changed_when: false

    - name: Restart sshd
      service:
        name: sshd
        state: restarted
      when: node2_sshd_conf.changed
